model_output.verdict: A structural and pipe welder whose inspection record and fit-up work make a strong case.
write_up: A recruiter sees a welder and fitter with structural steel and process piping experience, backed by named certifications. The work is specific enough to move forward. The plant shutdown line is the main place where the job itself gets lost.

The Riverfront Tower inspection line is the model: it names the job, the inspection methods and about how many welds were involved. The fit-up tolerance and named welding processes give the rest of the work useful detail too.

cards.line: - Passed every third-party UT and visual inspection on the Riverfront Tower job (about 900 welds)
cards.cannot_tell: Keep this. The named job, inspection methods and weld count tell a recruiter what was checked and how it went.
